idea: Click matching controls to extend, retract, translate, or later rotate capped slider assemblies until every fixed magenta target is covered by a movable magenta marker. There is no avatar; most pieces are 3-pixel-thick sliders with a fixed gray cap and a moving free end, and one control affects every same-colored piece. Some sliders carry child pieces recursively, so moving a parent moves its descendants while child controls can still adjust relative offsets. Levels should teach independent extension, stacked child sliders, movable wall assemblies, same-color coupling, collision rollback against walls or pieces, rotation controls, and final target placement where a temporary structure must be built, shifted, and dismantled without overlap.
title: Sliders
